recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not restore the old ICD-9/ICD-10 text or duplicate detailed ICD policy in core; further ICD canonical details should remain coordinated with the THO ICD guidance page.
issue_request: FHIR-20193 was Published with a Not Persuasive with Modification resolution after the reporter noted that the ICD-9 and ICD-10 values in the first URI column of terminologies-systems.html were not valid URIs. The accepted direction was to point readers to ICD guidance because multiple ICD URIs exist.
initial_application: Commit 9500b398d1 applied FHIR-20193 in a Vocabulary R5 ticket batch by adding guidance that there are multiple ICD URIs and readers should see the ICD page, but it left the first-column text as ICD-9, ICD-10. Commit 81e5862f20 for FHIR-35933 later moved the Using ICD guidance link to THO and adjusted the table structure.
additional_context: terminologies-systems.html is a current build page via publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. FHIR-41305 later re-raised the same URI-column defect for R5 and was Applied for R6; commit 11181dd489 replaced the ICD-9/ICD-10 label with URI strings and fixed the Source cell formatting, and f628812336 cleaned the local href targets. Confluence minutes for 2021-07-28 support the original decision, and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
